Mixed purées

Spinach and potato

Spenótos burgonya

6 months+ Replaced 30 min 4 portions

Serve as a mixed bowl, not a plate of spinach alone. Use tap water, not water from a private well.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 300 g potatoes (peeled weight)
  • 60 g spinach (washed leaves, a small share of the bowl)
  • 60 g cooked pear or peas (peeled cored pear, or peas, for vitamin C)
  • as needed to cook tap water (not water from a private well)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Peel the potatoes and boil them in tap water until soft.
  2. Add the spinach for the last 2 minutes, until wilted.
  3. Stir in cooked pear or peas.
  4. Drain, keeping a spoon of the tap cooking water, and blend until smooth.
  5. Do not cook this in water from a private well, and do not add salt.

Replaced

The usual green stew relied on sorrel, or on spinach as the whole dish. Sorrel is a poor everyday green for infants because it is high in oxalate.

Make a potato and spinach mash with cooked pear or peas for vitamin C, and keep spinach as one part of the meal rather than the only vegetable. Do not cook it in water from a private well, which can be high in nitrate, and do not use sorrel.
